info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Outlet Management API
info.description: The Outlet Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage their retail outlets. This endpoint allows for the deletion of an outlet based on its unique identifier. Typical consumers of this API include retail managers and system administrators looking to maintain an accurate outlet inventory. By utilizing this operation, organizations can ensure that their outlet data remains current and relevant, supporting effective operational management.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to permanently delete the specified outlet from the system. Use caution as this action cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: Request body to delete the outlet with the specified identifier. Ensure that the outlet ID is correct and that you have the necessary permissions to perform this operation.

DeleteOutletRes100045Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation on outlets. The expected format is a string, which can be used to convey relevant information related to the deletion.

metadata.description: Contains metadata related to the response for the DELETE operation.

DeleteOutletRes100045Response_204.description: Response schema for a successful DELETE operation, returning metadata.

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: An identifier used to correlate this response with the original request.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region in which the processing occurred.

ResponseMetadata.description: Metadata information associated with the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: The unique identifier for the endpoint being accessed.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that processed the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer token format for authentication, specifically leveraging JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Users must include a valid JWT in the 'Authorization' header in the format: 'Bearer <token>'. This allows secure access to protected resources within the API.
